Flat A of floor 2 is immediately above flat A of floor 1 and immediately below flat A of floor 3, and so on; the same holds for flat B. The lowermost floor is numbered 1 and the topmost floor is numbered 4. Exactly one person lives in each flat.

2. U lives to the west of R.
3. S and R live in different types of flats.
4. R lives on a floor below the floor of V.
5. U and Q live on adjacent floors.
6. P lives in the same type of flat as W.
7. W lives in the same type of flat as T.
8. T lives on an even-numbered floor.
9. U lives on the floor immediately below the floor of T.
10. W lives on the floor immediately above the floor of S.

questions.prompt: Who lives immediately above P?

steps: No clue fixes a position outright, so begin with the clues that limit the options most.
Now T can be in flat A of floor 4 or flat B of floor 4 (clues 1 and 8) — make 2 cases.
Case T in flat A of floor 4: no place is left for U — rejected.
Case T in flat B of floor 4 survives.
Now U can be in flat A of floor 3 or flat B of floor 3 (clue 9) — make 2 cases.
Case U in flat B of floor 3: clue 2 cannot be satisfied — rejected.
Case U in flat A of floor 3 survives.
Clue 2 → R in flat B of floor 3; Clue 4 → V in flat A of floor 4.
Now Q can be in flat A of floor 2 or flat B of floor 2 (clue 5) — make 2 cases.
Case Q in flat B of floor 2: clue 6 cannot be satisfied — rejected.
Case Q in flat A of floor 2 survives.
S takes the only place left: flat A of floor 1; Clues 7 and 10 → W in flat B of floor 2.
P takes the only place left: flat B of floor 1.
Final arrangement (A | B): floor 4: V | T; floor 3: U | R; floor 2: Q | W; floor 1: S | P.
P lives in flat B of floor 1; the flat immediately above it is flat B of floor 2 → **W**.

solution.trap: **Q** lives on that floor but in the other flat — "immediately above/below" means the same type of flat.
